verdict.rationale: Clara's first-party agent-instructions page refers to a 'Clara MCP' that lets an AI assistant inspect or act on Clara data, such as listing cards, reviewing transactions, switching companies and locking cards. That is direct evidence an official MCP server exists, but the pack shows no setup or connection details. missing for 10: MCP server endpoint/install and connection instructions, auth flow for MCP clients, full tool inventory, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can connect.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Use Clara MCP when the user wants an AI assistant to inspect or act on Clara data in natural language, such as listing cards, reviewing transactions, switching companies, or locking a card
Always confirm the destination, amount, and date with the user before creating a Pix payment (`POST /api/v3/accounts-payable/pix`) — it moves money.
